baseline_comparisons.interpretation: Added two committed saves, live indicator reads and capture extend the workload. Functional regressions and existing gate outcomes are compared; peak changes are not a like-for-like performance improvement or a memory-climb fix.

review: No remaining findings after retaining claimed old-book work, preserving captured-toggle success semantics, checking post-capture pending bytes and grading every owned cleanup receipt.
limitations: Linux isolated dmabuf-llvmpipe evidence. No scheduler bound, mirror settings authority, persistence soak, memory-climb status or platform certification changed. Disabled books emit at most one pending refresh per reset, even when background claims clear their dirty bit. No-op completion state has an actual no-op host test; native controls falsify pending/completion event wiring on real saves.
instrument_correction: Initial stress attempts retained the enable panel because its disabled toggle lost focus. Their markers never reached storage; both failed results and a capture are retained. The final probe dismisses the panel by an outside header click, focuses visible prose, then types at the scene end.
